conversation_starters.summary: Crews battled wildfires in and around the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness (BWCA) and Superior National Forest, a heavily forested region in northern Minnesota popular with canoeists. Early in the week, officials reported improving containment and prepared to reopen about 70% of the area's canoe entry points, with nearly 1,000 firefighters still working the flames. As the week progressed, rain helped slow the fires and evacuation plans began shifting, though closures, evacuations, and fire restrictions stayed in place and officials continued urging caution for residents and visitors.

you_should_know.title: Minnesota enacts first-of-its-kind ban on AI "nudification" tech, but not without obstacles
you_should_know.summary: Minnesota moved to enact a first-of-its-kind ban on AI "nudification" technology, set to take effect August 1. An AI company founded by Elon Musk sued, arguing the ban violated free speech, and sought a temporary restraining order to block it. A U.S. District Court judge denied that request, allowing the law to proceed, though a further federal court hearing was scheduled for later in the month. A state senator who championed the law spoke in support of keeping it in place.
